text: dsh-dual-auto 是一款为 DSH 提供双模型自动路由的工具插件，通过三个工具先按任务领域、长度、上下文数、置信度、新颖度和规则冲突判断是否升级，再由运行工具调用 DeepSeek 模型。它支持 Flash 直返、Pro 升级、升级调用失败后降级到 Flash，并能把错误反馈记入指纹学习，使同类任务后续升级。路由还会记录成本、延迟与决策日志，状态保存在 DSH 提供的文件服务中。适合希望按任务难度选择模型、并对错误决策持续校正的 DSH 用户；实际模型调用需要可用的 deepseek-official 服务。

dsh-dual-auto routes DSH tasks to DeepSeek Flash or Pro based on task signals. It supports Flash fallback when an upgrade call fails, learns from incorrect results, and stores routing state through DSH file services. Real calls need an available DeepSeek service.
想让 DSH 根据任务难度自动选择便宜或更强的模型。
短任务直接用 Flash，复杂任务再升级到 Pro 可以吗？
让模型调用失败时自动尝试较轻量的模型。
希望把回答错误的任务记下来，下次同类问题改用更强模型。
需要按领域、置信度和上下文数量决定是否升级模型。
Can DSH route simple tasks to Flash and escalate harder ones to Pro?
I want incorrect direct answers to teach the router to upgrade similar tasks next time.
想保留模型路由的决策记录和统计，便于查看升级情况。
dsh-dual-auto 的功能「按任务条件路由」：dual_model_route 根据任务领域、规则冲突、文本长度、上下文数量、置信度和新颖度返回直返或升级决策，并记录指纹、原因、成本和延迟。
dsh-dual-auto 的功能「路由并调用模型」：dual_model_run 按决策选择 deepseek-v4-flash 或 deepseek-v4-pro；升级调用失败时改用 Flash，并返回模型结果或调用错误。
dsh-dual-auto 的功能「错误反馈与逃逸学习」：dual_model_mark 接收任务及正确性标记；错误反馈会学习该任务指纹，使同指纹后续路由升级，命中达到阈值后可衰减移除。
dsh-dual-auto 使用前须知：真实运行会把任务文本发送给 deepseek-official provider，并通过 DSH 文件服务保存指纹、统计及决策日志；相关路径在插件源码中配置。

@lengquan88/dsh-dual-auto README · dsh-dual-auto：**Dual-model auto-routing plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh).**

Low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop.

@lengquan88/dsh-dual-auto README · Enable：Add one row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dual-auto
      name: '@lengquan88/dsh-dual-auto'
```

Restart `dsh web`. The tools `dual_model_route`, `dual_model_run`, and
`dual_model_mark` become available in every session.

@lengquan88/dsh-dual-auto README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `dual_model_route` | Six-criteria routing decision (length / context / domain coverage / rule conflict / confidence / novelty → six labels). Fingerprints that escaped once are force-upgraded. |
| `dual_model_run` | Decision + real model call: `direct` → `deepseek-v4-flash`, `upgrade` → `deepseek-v4-pro` (auto-degrade to flash on failure, marked `degraded`). Probe tasks auto-validate against a gold set — wrong direct answers trigger escape learning. |
| `dual_model_mark` | Mark the quality of a direct result. `correct=false` learns the fingerprint and rewrites the disk log marker; the same fingerprint is force-upgraded next time. |
